description: A podcast about leadership, life, and stress management — hosted by a manager who is doing all of it while managing ADHD and perimenopause, and isn't going to pretend otherwise.

episodes.title: The Bar Is Clear Enough
episodes.summary: What 'good enough leadership' actually looks like when you're managing a team, your own brain, and your own body all at the same time.

episodes.title: Nobody Told Me This Would Happen At Work
episodes.summary: Perimenopause symptoms don't check your calendar. A real conversation about showing up to lead through them anyway.

episodes.title: The Burnout Math
episodes.summary: Why doing 40% today and 100% tomorrow beats doing 120% today and nothing for three days — and how to actually believe that.
